objectList.moreTip: More: clone, rename, mirror, export… (or right-click the object)
objectList.groupHint: Move, rotate and scale work on all of them. Right-click a chosen model, or long press it on a phone, for the rest.

objectList.simplifyTip: Fewer triangles, like desktop's Simplify model
objectList.deleteTip: The object with all its copies (Del removes only the picked copy)
